Construct random, spatial-block, buffered, or kNNDM folds

Source: R/folds.R
spatial_folds.Rd

Spatial blocks use coordinate k-means. Buffered folds remove training observations within buffer of any test observation. The kNNDM method calls CAST::knndm() and requires the optional packages 'CAST' and 'sf'. Its target must have equal weights. All methods return explicit indices suitable for audit_cv(). These constructors do not use response values.

Usage

spatial_folds(
  locations,
  k = 5L,
  method = c("random", "block", "buffered", "knndm"),
  buffer = NULL,
  target = NULL,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

locations

Numeric two-column coordinates or projected spatial points.

k

Number of folds, between two and the number of observations.

method

One of "random", "block", "buffered", or "knndm".

buffer

Nonnegative exclusion distance, required for buffered CV and expressed in the same units as the coordinates.

target

Prediction target, required for kNNDM.

seed

An integer seed. The default is reproducible and restores the caller's random-number state, including after calls to external constructors. Use NULL to use and advance the caller's random-number stream.

Value

Validated cv_folds() with explicit training and test indices.

Examples

xy <- cbind(seq_len(12), rep(c(0, 1), 6))
spatial_folds(xy, k = 3, method = "random", seed = 10)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$train
#> [1]  2  3  4  6  7  9 11 12
#> 
#> [[1]]$test
#> [1]  1  5  8 10
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]]$train
#> [1]  1  3  4  5  8 10 11 12
#> 
#> [[2]]$test
#> [1] 2 6 7 9
#> 
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [[3]]$train
#> [1]  1  2  5  6  7  8  9 10
#> 
#> [[3]]$test
#> [1]  3  4 11 12
#> 
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "spcv_folds" "list"      
#> attr(,"n")
#> [1] 12
